patches: >Securing the future of banking(?:|\s+)with agentic AI(?:|\s+)and post-quantum cryptography\.
>Tabbatar da makomar banki da AI mai cin gashin kai da kiriftografi bayan kwantum.
>Built for the edge\. Architected for uncompromising resilience\. Powering the next generation of global payments\.
>An gina shi don edge. An tsara shi don juriya wadda ba ta yarda da sasanci ba. Yana ƙarfafa ƙarni na gaba na biyan kuɗi a duniya.
>(?:Open source for the future of finance|Open-source foundations for wholesale finance)\.<

>A portfolio of Python, Rust and JavaScript libraries I created and maintain\. Open source, free to use, and applied to wholesale payments, cross-border settlement, financial data and quantum-resistant cryptography\.<

>Tarin ɗakunan karatu na Python, Rust da JavaScript da na ƙirƙira kuma nake kula da su. Buɗaɗɗen tushe, kyauta don amfani, kuma ana amfani da su wajen biyan kuɗi na manyan cibiyoyi, sasanta biyan kuɗi tsakanin ƙasashe, bayanan kuɗi da kiriftografi mai jure wa kwamfutar kwantum.<
ISO 20022, end to end: pain\.001, pacs\.008, camt\.053, and acmt\.001\. Adopt one library at a time\.
ISO 20022 daga farko zuwa ƙarshe: pain.001, pacs.008, camt.053 da acmt.001. Ɗauki ɗakin karatu ɗaya a lokaci guda.
Post-quantum primitives: ML-KEM \(CRYSTALS-Kyber, NIST FIPS 203\) and hashing, ready to pilot today\.
Ginshiƙan bayan kwantum: ML-KEM (CRYSTALS-Kyber, NIST FIPS 203) da hashing, a shirye don gwaji tun yau.
Audited Rust libraries and a code security scanner, signed and shipped with a software bill of materials\.
Ɗakunan karatu na Rust da aka tantance da na'urar binciken tsaron lamba, an sa musu hannu kuma ana fitar da su tare da jerin kayan software (SBOM).

Quantum computing threatens the cryptographic foundations of financial services\.\s*Payments, from real-time to cross-border settlement, rely on protections that quantum computing will eventually render obsolete\.

Kwamfutar kwantum na barazana ga ginshiƙan kiriftografi na ayyukan kuɗi. Biyan kuɗi, daga na nan take zuwa sasantawa tsakanin ƙasashe, sun dogara ne kan kariyar da kwamfutar kwantum za ta mayar marasa amfani a ƙarshe.
>Quantum-Safe Payments white paper · September 2025 · Read the paper<
>Farar takardar Quantum-Safe Payments · Satumba 2025 · Karanta farar takardar<
>More than 20 years in payments, banking and digital technology\.
>Fiye da shekaru 20 a fannin biyan kuɗi, banki da fasahar dijital.
>Industry white paper for the Emerging Payments Association Asia\.\s*The structural threat quantum computing poses to payment infrastructure, and the case for coordinated action now\.<
>Farar takardar masana'antu don Emerging Payments Association Asia. Barazanar tsari da kwamfutar kwantum ke yi wa ababen more rayuwa na biyan kuɗi, da hujjar ɗaukar matakin haɗin gwiwa yanzu.<
>Why the payments industry must act now\.<
>Dalilin da ya sa masana'antar biyan kuɗi dole ta ɗauki mataki yanzu.<

>Regulators are treating harvest-now-decrypt-later as a credible present risk\. This paper(?:, produced for the Emerging Payments Association Asia, sets out| outlines) the structural threat and the(?: urgent)? case for coordinated action across wholesale payment rails\.

>Masu sa ido suna ɗaukar "girbe yanzu, buɗe sirri daga baya" a matsayin haɗari na yanzu mai inganci. Wannan farar takarda, da aka shirya don Emerging Payments Association Asia, ta bayyana barazanar tsarin da hujjar ɗaukar matakin haɗin gwiwa a dukkan hanyoyin biyan kuɗi na manyan cibiyoyi.
>Recent research and writing on quantum-safe cryptography, ISO 20022 migration and the future of wholesale payments\.<
>Bincike da rubuce-rubuce na baya-bayan nan kan kiriftografi mai jure wa kwantum, ƙaura zuwa ISO 20022 da makomar biyan kuɗi na manyan cibiyoyi.<

Stablecoins cannot pay yield under the GENIUS Act\. BlackRock's BRSRV and BSTBL filings show the workaround — a tokenised money-market fund running alongside a regulated stablecoin to deliver yield through an adjacent, compliant rail\.

Stablecoin ba za su iya biyan riba ba a ƙarƙashin GENIUS Act. Takardun BRSRV da BSTBL na BlackRock sun nuna hanyar kauce wa hakan: asusun kasuwar kuɗi da aka mayar token wanda ke aiki tare da stablecoin mai lasisi, don isar da riba ta wata hanya maƙwabciya mai bin doka.

Quantum risk has moved from research curiosity to active regulatory mandate\. With the G7 roadmap published in January 2026 and BIS Project Leap proving feasibility in live payment systems, the board-level question is no longer whether to migrate\.

Haɗarin kwantum ya koma daga abin sha'awar bincike zuwa umarnin doka mai aiki. Tare da taswirar G7 da aka wallafa a watan Janairu 2026 da BIS Project Leap da ya tabbatar da yiwuwa a tsarin biyan kuɗi na gaske, tambayar da ke gaban kwamitin gudanarwa ba ita ce ko za a yi ƙaura ba.

From November 2026, SWIFT CBPR\+ rejects unstructured postal addresses in cross-border payment messages\. Six months out, 65% of pacs\.008 messages still ship non-compliant addresses and 44% of banks remain behind on the remediation programme\.

Daga Nuwamba 2026, SWIFT CBPR+ za ta ƙi adireshin gidan waya marasa tsari a saƙonnin biyan kuɗi tsakanin ƙasashe. Watanni shida kafin lokacin, kashi 65% na saƙonnin pacs.008 har yanzu suna aika adireshin da ba su bi ƙa'ida ba, kuma kashi 44% na bankuna suna baya a shirin gyarawa.
